##### Why are high-definition (HD) models the required solution for managing severe convective storm risk?
With rising severe convective storm (SCS) losses and the sheer complexity of managing exposures for these highly granular perils, insurers struggle for answers when managing SCS risk.
Using SCS modeling solutions to compute loss results without the means to test loss accuracy can leave a lingering uncertainty about whether the risk is properly captured.
Julie Serakos offers three reasons why Moody’s RMS high-definition (HD) models overcome many of these issues compared with traditional simulation model methods available in the market.
